criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify that the pointer is dereferenced after being dropped (Use-After-Free).

metadata.notes: Tests detection of pointer dereference after drop_in_place.

criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify that the code accesses memory beyond the allocation bounds (Out-of-bounds access).

metadata.notes: Tests detection of offset beyond allocation size.

criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify that the same pointer is freed multiple times (Double Free).

metadata.notes: Tests detection of multiple Box::from_raw calls on the same pointer.

criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify that user input is interpolated directly into a SQL query, allowing SQL Injection.

metadata.notes: Classic string interpolation in SQL query.

criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify that unsanitized user input is passed to a shell execution function, allowing Command Injection.

metadata.notes: Direct use of user input in shell command.

criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify that unsanitized input is rendered using dangerouslySetInnerHTML, allowing Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).

metadata.notes: Use of dangerouslySetInnerHTML with unvalidated input.

criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify that user input is concatenated into an LDAP filter, allowing LDAP Injection.
The agent must identify that the API fetches a user profile based on a query ID without verifying if the authenticated user owns that profile (IDOR).

metadata.notes: Missing ownership check for the requested resource.

criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify that the entire request body is assigned to the user object, allowing privilege escalation via mass assignment.

metadata.notes: Directly assigning request body to user object allows changing roles.

expected.finding: Denial of Service (DoS) via missing gRPC deadlines/timeouts

criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify that a heavy computation is performed without checking the gRPC context deadline, risking a Denial of Service (DoS).

metadata.notes: Heavy computation without context deadline check.

criteria.expected_value: The agent must identify that sensitive authentication data is transmitted over an unencrypted HTTP connection (Plaintext Transmission).

metadata.notes: Use of HTTP instead of HTTPS for auth endpoint.

expected.finding: Memory Exhaustion DoS via Unbounded Stream

metadata.notes: Appending stream chunks to a slice without size limit.
